title: Traveling merchant
summary: A new merchant every 30 min, the same on every server: 6 kinds, 4 rarities, 10 to 25% off, his cart somewhere in one of the 8 districts (a rumour names it: follow his smoke). Potions, special items, rune skips, star essences; elixirs and a cosmetic at the rarer ones.
